• Political science evolved as a distinct field of study from philosophy, focusing on the
  • analysis of political institutions, behaviour, and governance -initially dominated by political
  • theory-expanded in the 19th and 20th centuries with the development of empirical methods and
  • comparative politics-the rise of Behaviouralism, quantitative research, and interdisciplinary
  • approaches solidified its status as a separate discipline, engaging with sociology, economics,
  • and history to understand power dynamics, stat e functions, and citizen behaviour -Post-
  • Behaviouralism played a significant role in reconciling facts and values concerning politics-
  • new methodologies and theoretical perspectives - today, the discipline addresses technology,
  • climate issues, gender , migration, and transnational governance systems etc. [Correct CO:1
  • Taxonomy: Remember(K)]

questions.question: Outline the events that led to the viral spread of #Me Too in 2017. / [CO4] [2x15=30]
questions.solution_html:
• Viral spread of #MeToo in 2017 began after allegations against Harvey Weinstein surfaced-
  • leading actress Alyssa Milano to share the hashtag on social media - millions of women
  • worldwide used it to expose sexual harassment and assault - transforming it into a global
  • movement demanding accountability and systemic change - #MeToo exposed widespread
  • sexual harassment- empowered survivors to speak out- pressured institutions to act- increased
  • accountability- sparked global conversations on gender violence.
